subject: Gauntlet Labs RFP: request for additional trial credits and extension
messages:
From: Lena Brooks <lena@gauntlet.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@gauntlet.ai>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:12:00Z
Subject: RFP run next week — request for trial top-up and extension

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team loved the latency profile and the cost analysis you shared. We're gearing up for the vendor bake-off next Tuesday and expect a heavier-than-anticipated token burn when we run our end-to-end scoring suite across three datasets.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide an additional 200k eval credits (tokens) for the Gauntlet vendor comparison?
- Can you extend our trial window by 30 days so we can finish the benchmark and include a second data pass?

This RFP pits Redwood against two incumbents; our procurement team treats the trial allocation as a factor in final scoring. If we can get the credits and an extension by EOD Tuesday, we can include Redwood in the final 6-page vendor appendix.

I've attached our MVP evaluation map (gauntlet_mvp_map.xlsx) showing expected token usage per dataset. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through numbers.

Best,
Lena Brooks
Head of ML Ops, Gauntlet Labs
lenab@gauntlet.ai

Attachment: gauntlet_mvp_map.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Brooks <lena@gauntlet.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: RFP run next week — request for trial top-up and extension

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and for sharing the MVP map. Great to hear the demo landed well.

I want to move quickly on this. My initial read from the usage sheet: 200k tokens is reasonable but it's above our usual self-serve top-ups. I'll loop in Sales Ops and Marissa for approval. For speed, can you confirm:
- Does the benchmark include any private PII data or PHI? (we need this for Private deployment / audit escalation)
- Will Gauntlet be OK with a short credit escrow clause (credits expire if vendor selection is made in favor of a competitor)?

HubSpot deal: GNT-4821 — I will add a note and the evaluation plan. I dropped a short mutual-action plan in Google Drive and linked it to the deal (see link). If Ops can approve a partial top-up immediately, we'll do a provisional allocation so your run isn't delayed.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0122

Date: 2026-09-08T15:40:00Z
Subject: RE: RFP run next week — request for trial top-up and extension

Jordan — thanks for the ping and the usage breakdown. Reviewed gauntlet_mvp_map.xlsx. Sales Ops position: we can authorize a provisional 75,000-token top-up immediately (14-day extension) to unblock their benchmark, w/ standard evaluation logging. Anything above that requires manager approval and an escrow/usage attestation.

If Marissa signs off we can:
- Provision 75k tokens today against deal GNT-4821 (no invoice; promotional credit).
- Provide a 14-day trial extension from the current expiration.
- Require Gauntlet to accept the attached credit terms spreadsheet and the telemetry export (read-only access) for audit.

I've attached credits-approval.xlsx for the ledger entry and the temporary credit grant template. If Marissa prefers to offer a larger top-up, propose she use the amendment template and route to Finance for a billing hold.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: credits-approval.xlsx (spreadsheet, 9KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T17:22:00Z
Subject: Re: RFP run next week — request for trial top-up and extension

Jordan / Ben — reviewed. Gauntlet is a strategic target in our healthcare vertical bench of prospects (their later-stage customers include regulated partners). I'll approve a one-time discretionary increase to support the RFP, with the following conditions:

1) We will provision 150,000 eval tokens total and extend the trial window by 21 days from their current expiry.
2) Credits are conditional: if Gauntlet signs another vendor during the evaluation period, unused credits will be forfeited (escrow clause).
3) Gauntlet must enable telemetry exports for the evaluation window and share a short post-bakeoff usage summary.
4) Legal to sign the small amendment — attached approved_redwood_amendment.pdf. Finance to place a billing hold pending final procurement outcome.

Jordan, please confirm you will send the confirmation and the amendment link to Lena and request formal acceptance. Ben — update the credits ledger and route the amendment to Legal/Finance.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales — Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Thanks — looking forward to supporting the bake-off.
